en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate wooden signpost in a village street. The post is topped with carved figures, including people and animals, and has several directional arms labelled with town names. Traditional timber houses and a small fountain or well are visible in the background. Caption text appears along the bottom border in German, and a photo credit is printed at the lower right.
